test: C9: the page opens the note with the edit pane of the Obsidian host (cc_editor_opens, cc_core_only) > nothing is written while the note is above the gate: the page shows why, with no editor, and the note is as it was
evidence: The page already refused a note above the gate before this change: it said why in words and offered no editor, and the server wrote nothing. The case pins that for the new editing page, so it passes against the old code too; the cases that fail there are the ones that need the editor.
